name: home-network-diagnosis-expert
description: Home network diagnostic expert for broadband/WiFi/router issues: latency, jitter, speed, DNS, IPv6, bufferbloat, security posture, and tiered remediation.

displayDescription.en: Reads home-network self-check data, pinpoints the cause of lag (local/router/ISP), and delivers actionable router QoS/SQM tuning and ISP escalation steps.
displayDescription.zh: 解读家庭网络自检数据，定位卡顿根因，给出路由器 QoS 调优与运营商报修的可执行方案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我看看这份网络自检数据，哪些指标有问题？
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me interpret this network self-check data — what's wrong?
